_info: House of the Wolf: the roster is in units.json (knights), here glory and starting passives. Glory is the house's shared reserve: filled by the heroes' deeds, spent in events and on broken oaths (abilities no longer cost it), carry_max = how much glory the house carries into the next battle of the run. successors = names of the successors of the fallen by class (in order), start_passives = heroes' passives and oaths at the start (in the prototype the tank has Never Retreat only for trial; in the game they are run rewards). trial_bonds = trial bonds in the free battle (so combos can be tried); in a run bonds form through shared victories.
name: House of the Wolf
